maddeler.e:
استلما (form VIII)
# اِسْتَلَمَا (istalamā) /is.ta.la.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# اُسْتُلِمَا (ustulimā) /us.tu.li.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# اِسْتَلِمَا (istalimā) /is.ta.li.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
